submissions.title: Published
submissions.author: Elizabeth Collado
submissions.summary: Hub direction: a simple, bright, reassuring hub with larger text, clear buttons, and a phone-tested passcode sign-in. Identity: Elizabeth frames the hub around feeling secure, capable, and less overwhelmed while checking tasks, wins, and ideas.
submissions.excerpt: I used Claude to assist me in setting up a sign-in with a passcode. It took a while, but it has been tested several times for security issues, and poof! It’s there on my phone, asking for the passcode. Love it! A new look for my Hub - simple, bright, and reassuring, with larger text and clear buttons so I can check tasks, wins, and ideas without feeling overwhelmed.

submissions.title: Challenge #1: Paint your AI Hub
submissions.author: Viktor Hung
submissions.summary: Hub direction: Quiet Command uses warm paper-and-ink tones with one forest-green accent for a restrained, personal command center. Identity: Viktor connects the look to his own quiet-versus-loud rule: useful and personal without becoming performative.
submissions.excerpt: I made it - FINALLY!!! 1. My direction in one line: "Quiet Command (Paper/Ink) — warm notebook tones + one consistent forest-green accent everywhere, because 'quiet vs loud' is my own rule: restrained and personal, not performative." 2. My Design Brief: LOVABLE-UI-HANDOFF.md
